reason: A Jenkins integration plugin that configures multiple servers, triggers parameterized jobs from workspace or model tools, polls build status, and maintains run history.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中配置多个 Jenkins 服务器、执行带参数的 Job 构建并查看运行状态与历史记录。
summaries.en: Configures multiple Jenkins servers in DeepSeek Harness, triggers parameterized jobs, and displays build status and run history.

capabilities: Configures multiple Jenkins servers with usernames and tokens
Connects to Jenkins through the host shell using curl
Triggers Jenkins jobs with workspace-defined parameters
Polls queued and running job status and records run history
Optionally skips TLS certificate verification when configured
